description: Enhanced round-trip encoding coverage disjoint from the native suite. Exercises additional header shapes: an explicitly empty {} context (distinct from null), a multi-entry encryption context, longer/different provider id and info labels with a larger encrypted key, a zero-length provider id and info with the minimum positive frame length (1), a multi-byte UTF-8 context value, and the maximum 32-bit frame length. Each verifies serialized_length is determined purely by field sizes and that decode/re-encode is byte-for-byte stable.
